package day5;

public class Program_EvenOddArray {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
int[]arr= {11, 24, 35, 42, 56, 67, 80, 93};
int sum=0; int counter=0;
for (int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
{
	if (arr[i]%2==0)
		sum++;
	else
		counter++;
}
System.out.println("Even numbers:"+" "+sum);
System.out.println("Odd numbers:"+" "+counter);
	}

}
